description: This file contains implementation of various externally-allocated kernel classes and helper functions related to MKLDNN (Math Kernel Library Deep Neural Network) IR (Intermediate Representation) constructs within PyTorch's compiler infrastructure. It includes classes for convolution, linear, and RNN operations with support for quantization, fusion, and layout management, primarily targeting CPU/XPU devices.

classes.name: ConvolutionUnary
classes.description: Represents an external kernel for 1D/2D/3D convolution with support for creation, code generation, and layout management.

classes.name: ConvolutionBinary
classes.description: Represents an external kernel for binary convolution operations, including creation and codegen.

classes.name: ConvolutionBinaryInplace
classes.description: Implements an in-place binary convolution kernel with mutation outputs.

classes.name: ConvolutionTransposeUnary
classes.description: Represents transposed convolution (deconvolution) with support for creation and codegen.

classes.name: QConvPointWisePT2E
classes.description: Quantized convolution pointwise operation for PT2E backend, supporting creation, codegen, and quantization parameters.

classes.name: QConvPointWiseBinaryPT2E
classes.description: Quantized binary convolution pointwise operation with support for creation, codegen, and in-place mutation.

classes.name: MKLPackedLinear
classes.description: MKL backend packed linear (fully connected) layer implementation.

classes.name: LinearUnary
classes.description: Unary linear layer kernel class supporting creation and codegen.

classes.name: LinearBinary
classes.description: Binary linear layer kernel class supporting creation and codegen.

classes.name: QLinearPointwisePT2E
classes.description: Quantized linear pointwise operation for PT2E backend, supporting creation, codegen, and bias handling.

classes.name: QLinearPointwiseBinaryPT2E
classes.description: Quantized binary linear pointwise operation with creation and in-place mutation support.

classes.name: MkldnnRnnLayer
classes.description: MKLDNN RNN layer kernel class to support RNN operations with helper creation and codegen.

classes.name: WeightInt4PackMatmul
classes.description: Packed weight matrix multiplication kernel for quantized int4 weights.
